title: Phantom Arsenal - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Phantom Arsenal trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Phantom Arsenal phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Tempering is refundable, so materials spent here are not lost - the only cost is the run back to the forge.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 29 of 36 on the list - before it Listen to Every Flower · after it Skill Over Strength. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
